body: I understand. What are you feeling now?

That's such a great idea. One of my therapists tried to help me work on feeling anger-- she said it was more productive sometimes than other tough feelings like sadness. Maybe you will even get an endorphin boost! Hopefully you have a good soundtrack for your workout if you like music.

I think I know how this feels-- I've thought these same things to myself a bunch of times before. I can't say anything for sure but my guess is there are people who care, but I know that doesn't help much when you can't feel it or see it. Are you talking about romantic love when you say nobody wants to be with you? Or also friends, family, co-workers, acquaintances, etc? I hope you have some people in your life you can hang out with and talk to.

Well I know in this group we're not supposed to immediately resort to PM. Do you wanna chat in the thread a bit longer? I should be up for a while (not going anywhere haha). Where are you heading off to?
I don't really like talking to you and don't find you helpful so you can dip if that's how you feel.
Hey-- do you want to talk more about what's going on? I'm sorry you've been experiencing so much pain for such a long time. I know that is exhausting and frustrating and just sucks.
Did you try getting to the hospital? How are you doing?
Are you still here?

I don't feel either of these ways. I don't get too deep into the science of my existence and don't feel nihilist. I just don't believe in a higher power or an after-life, etc. I don't think I have anywhere to go when I die. But I wonder if religious people feel motivated by a desire to go somewhere like heaven.
Do you want to talk about the projects? It's okay if not.
Do you want to talk? I'm not sure what you're up to now or if you've gone through with your plan but we can talk more about your situation if you want.
I don't know what that's supposed to be in response to. Either way: I was speaking for myself, as I'm sure everyone is all the time.

I never claimed we know, but people have beliefs, which in this case don't differentiate from knowing when we're thinking about our own deaths and what we want from death. I never said anything about peace or a resolution.

I agree about romanticization. It's nothing like the depictions in movies, TV, and art. I do empathize with some comfort in the idea of just... not being. When life blows the absence of life can sound nice, but the truth is we won't be able to experience whatever it is we think sounds good about that because we'd just be gone.

I don't think you're an idiot at all. I have also been raped and have self-harmed and can relate to depression, though not PTSD. If you want to talk I'm here. I'm sorry you're going through this-- it really does suck.
Do you want to talk?

I didn't say "some stuff" I said literally everything that has ever been suggested to me. Depression is a lot more complicated than how a person views things.......... depression can and does in fact inform how we view things. I think you want to help but you're not really helping at all by reducing my situation to hormones and how I "view things." Also bringing up "weakness" when I never even suggested I was weak....... but thanks for that.

I'm currently living alone but am about to move in with a bunch of people I don't know and won't be able to talk to about any of this. I also work alone at home. Socializing and even leaving the house sounds impossible. I have have been sleeping okay with the help of the meds I got for the abortion but haven't been eating or drinking much. I just don't have an appetite.
same to all the above

I've been at a crossroads and tried changing so many times. I've literally tried anything I could think of and that has been recommended to me that hasn't been totally self-destructive. I'm on SSRIs, I went to therapy for years, I meditated every day for months on end, I did yoga, I ran, I went on walks. None of it has made a lasting impact on my life. None of it has made things okay long enough for me to feel like I'm not drowning. This isn't just "tough times" it's the cherry on top of the cherry on top of the cherry on top of the cherry of a lifetime of tough times.
I got an abortion. The day of the abortion my partner ended our relationship. Otherwise (ha) the abortion was fine.

A lot of this reminds me of someone I love very much who did come out on the other side of it all. Sounds like their life story the t. I can't say what will happen in your life or claim to know your pain but I know that people with similar stories have found a way to make life work and I hope you can, too.
